AIM.solver: use the whole table range 6..47; min range about 2.9 m (at 6 deg); prefer the higher pitch when two solutions exist
AIM.holds_by: printed self-locking worm (single start, lead about 5 deg)
AIM.one_way: swing-arm splitter (pawl-free), engages on BACKWARD wiper turns

deck: drill the rover, deck tiles, rover mount, heat-set inserts
motor: wiper motor on its adapter (bench), motor-side cheek, motor onto the cheek
drum_idler: wrap idler group (the idler posts drop in before the shift rail and the coupler bus gear block them)
main_shaft: shift rail, coupler hub on the wiper shaft, shear pin, outer coupler with the REEL gear and washer, index contact (before the reel bus gear c1 and the dog post)
reel_capstan: D50 front gears: reel wall, sleeve, bus gear c1, swing idler, cup shaft, cup gear, riser to K2, countershaft C and REEL idler, clutch hub, brake crank, rocker and bar, reel shaft, T2, SW_ARM
drum_shift: fork and dog contacts, drum B (keyed), hand lever, bracket B, N20, code switches
main_stack: LAUNCH dog ring, magnet cap, dog post
reel_storage: D50 reel unit on the deck extension: lane tabs and posts, P1 with sprag #2, capstan tube, lanes C, K, T, cheeks, T bracket, spool, drum, cup, rear trains, P2, line
launcher: rail bench sub-assembly (sleeve first), big gear (timed without springs), drive gear and sprag, carriage, stops, contacts, rail-rear pulley (D50), lip roller
aim: aim housing, worm, wheel, crank, splitter, lug, conrod
electronics: electronics bay, set the buck before wiring the DRV8833, wiring (battery unplugged), camera, receiver, cable anchors
guards: gear guards; spring guards go on with the springs at test stage 5
test_stage_only: steps done only at a test stage (springs: 999)

mp1584.note: buck, needed to feed the DRV8833 from the 3S

DART.belly: plain cylinder d 42 along x: the launcher cradle surface; legs stow on top and flanks

DRUM.order: LAUNCH / NEUTRAL / WRAP / (park WRAPPED in N_TO_R) / REEL (D16, D22)

zones.name: L_TO_N
zones.clutch: LIGHT (clutch ramps to FIRM over 30..40, after the collar shift)

zones.name: WRAP
zones.cup: 7 turns (4 pinion turns x 42/24), ends at home

zones.name: N_TO_R
zones.collar: NEUTRAL until 318, then ramp to REEL

fault_rules.from_REEL_or_N_TO_R: the drum HOLDS where it is (D27, MODE err DRUM_HELD), never NEUTRAL (that would run back through the wrap window and unwrap under tow); the operator unwraps when safe

n20.note: motor pointing up; cad-drum sizes the ratio with at least 2x margin (FIRM 5 N, D24)
n20.note_ratio: cad-drum as built (drum_NOTES sections 3 and 9); physics and firmware read these

DRUM.sw_index_mount: on drum idler post 2 (block on the +x side, screwed to a strut); index cam at s 33.5..38.5, base r 26 (cad-drum 13:45)
DRUM.shear_pin_print: lying down (pin axis flat on the bed) so the shear plane cuts across layers; a layer line on the shear plane slips at 2.5 to 3.3 N m, the same as the cock and tow torques (D44)

bus.note: D15/D25: no drag brake (the swing idler stays engaged under payout)

FRAME.origin: main axis at the wiper adapter plate face

ebay.note: on the deck in front of the drum; USB to the Jetson reachable

camera.note: D18: bore-sighted to the launch azimuth; cad-frame sets the final pose

rc832.note: holder with the antenna up and clear of metal (D18)

FRAMEWORK.rover_mount: flat deck with an M3 hole grid; the deck is its own drill template

drive_gear.note: on sprag #1 (inside, keyed), coaxial on the launch sleeve; face 11 for SF 1.5 at the 5 N m shear pin (physics, cad-launch 14:28)

big_gear.as_built: sector layer 27 teeth (rack) + full 40T layer face 11 (drive gear), cad-launch 14:28
big_gear.note: two layers: a sector layer meshes the rack (last tooth relieved, the one before 30 percent taller), a full 40T layer meshes the drive gear so every cock can start (D23)

stop.note: D6/D26: about 2.8 to 3.3 J per shot; a linear printed PLA flexure needs about 19 mm; TPU pads only if Harry gets TPU

flight.note: for the sim; physics on params 1.5.0 (D50): 4.70 m at 34 deg with the fixed LIGHT 0.25 N brake and the D50 payout path (gain 1.32, take-up chain inertia)

footprint.note: target for the main deck; cad-frame reports the real one. D50: a bolt-on extension tile carries the reel unit behind x -164 (REEL_UNIT deck_extension)

main.note: wiper output = main shaft = rail pivot; the launch sleeve (cad-launch) is coaxial on its d12 spigot

drum.note: front-below: clear of the big gear sweep (lowest z about -44) and of the reel gear zone (x <= 8)

capstan.note: D50: the old capstan axis, 72.1 from the main axis at 255 deg, now carries the cup gear (meshing cad-drum's wrap idler), the bus gear c1 and the cup shaft K (cad-reel frame R); the capstan itself is in the reel unit (reel_unit_capstan)

reel_unit_capstan.note: D50: capstan in the reel unit on the deck extension behind the launcher, axis along +X in the rail plane y 140, cup and axial eyelet in front (REEL_UNIT)

aim_crank.note: worm wheel = crank in cad-launch's aim housing (planes about y 186..225), confirmed by cad-launch

stack.part: drum_coupler: coupler hub on the wiper shaft (the hub reaches back to y -5 inside the puck bore, D48), printed PLA shear pin d4 at r 13 (D8, about 5 N m, 6 spares), outer coupler
TAKE-UP BUS gear m1.5 50T face 8 on the outer coupler (D15), downstream of the shear pin, upstream of the dog
REEL output gear m2 50T face 12, on a journal on the outer coupler; dogs to y 69.5 (as built)
dog collar at NEUTRAL (stroke 7 each way); fork groove y 82..88
LAUNCH dog ring, bolted to the launch sleeve flange (face at y 111); its joint follows the sleeve
LAUNCH sleeve: flange, rail cheek journals, drive gear 26T m2.5 on sprag #1 (y 142.5..158.5), splitter sun (y 170..182)
sleeve outboard bushing with the thrust face, in cad-launch's AIM HOUSING (stands on the deck; no frame seat on the sleeve)
main shaft d12 spigot through the launch sleeve bore (12.35), as built
AS5600 magnet cap on the spigot end (edge-on disc or 6 x 2.5 diametric)
AS5600 board bracket on the aim housing outer side (chip 1 to 2 mm from the magnet)

reel_frame_R.note: capstan gear plane R Z -29..-17 = world y 50.5..62.5 (meets the REEL gear); cup toward world -y

keep_out.rail_sweep: rail body and carriage between 6 (or the retrieve minimum) and 47 deg pitch, for y 95..185: behind and below the axis down to z about -125 at x about -150..-210, and the big gear down to z -45 in front
keep_out.wiper_body: gearbox and can above the axis (WIPER.orient_deg), y -56..0, plus the can along +z
keep_out.line: D50: the line from the spool through the cup eyelet, straight to the one 693ZZ pulley at the rail rear end, then along the rail to the dart tail, all in the rail plane y 140 (REEL_UNIT)
keep_out.reel_unit: D50: the reel unit sweep is fixed (nothing of it moves with the rail); the rail rear reaches world x -228 (pitch 22), the cup eyelet sits at x -240.6

capstan.backstop: sprag #2 on the capstan tube in the reel unit (wind-in only, D50)
capstan.note: D50: the 22T m2 gear sits on countershaft C (frame R), driven by the REEL gear through the 41T idler; bevel 20:20 into lane C, rear train 20T / 58T idler / 20T onto the capstan tube: ratio still 50/22

clutch.convention: line tension at the design pack radius r 27.0 mm (about 2 m out) of the d40 / d62 spool; the clutch hub drives the spool 1:1 (hub 28T / T2 28T, two 1:1 bevels, 16T / 34T idler / 16T)
clutch.note: D7, D24, D49, D50: LIGHT is a FIXED 0.25 N anti-overrun drag (payout, cock take-up), FIRM 5 N for tidy and the final approach; set by cad-drum's brake track through cad-reel's bar, crank and rocker at the clutch hub (front, frame R), fail-safe LIGHT

storage.bearings: 2 x 608 (spool shaft in the reel unit cheeks)
storage.note: D50: free spool keyed on the spool shaft in the reel unit, axis along world Y, pack y 130..150 in the rail plane; the line leaves the pack top on the low-aim line through the cup eyelet

take_up.note: D25 / D50: compound c1 free on the stationary A0 sleeve meshes the bus 50T; the swing idler rides c1's hub and drives the reel gear 20T (clutch disk 2.5 x wiper) on forward turns; the clutch hub drives the spool 1:1 through T2, lane T and T3 (REEL_UNIT rear_trains t)

tow_tension_model.note: D50: dart-side line N = 14.4 x (I - I_free) - 2.5 (capstan side 17.0 / -3.0 through the unchanged 50/22 ratio, D42, divided by path_gain 1.18); tow_limit_n means the DART side; recalibrate with the luggage scale at the line end

current_trips_a.note: D8/D33/D40: every backward wiper run in LAUNCH (aim, decock, backward jog) drives the aim train: 3 A

REEL.pulleys: D50: one 693ZZ printed pulley at the rail rear end (the old top pulley); no other pulley on the line

cup_gear.note: driven by cad-drum's wrap idler output 42T m1.5 (4 pinion turns = 7 cup turns); D50: the K riser, bevel and rear train are all 1:1

eyelet.note: D49/D50: the v7 ring hole turned axial at radius 26, lug in front of the cup face; ring at the cup BOTTOM at home

REEL.line_path_hook: reel.line_path(P, S): spool pack top -> cup eyelet -> floor segment to the rail-rear pulley; launch.line_path continues over the pulley to the dart

REEL_UNIT.owner: cad-reel (reel unit, lanes, front gears), cad-frame (deck extension tile), cad-launch (rail-rear pulley)

lanes.note: world (y, z) of the three shafts along X from the front gears to the reel unit: C (capstan, d12), K (cup, d8), T (take-up, d8)

riser.note: K riser: cup shaft gear 30T, idlers 34T and 30T, K2 30T (1:1)

front.note: frame R gears in front of / behind the reel wall: C (22T m2 in the REEL plane, bevel m2 20:20 in front), K2 (riser gear and bevel m1.5 18:18), T2 (28T meshing the 28T clutch hub, bevel m1 20:20)

t.note: T3 16T, idler 34T, spool shaft 16T: light, the whole take-up chain turns with the spool in payout

rear_trains.note: C plane in front of the K plane; the I_c axle sits in P1, the I_k axle in P2

spool.note: clutch hub, friction disc, T2, bevels, lane T, T3 and the rear gears turn with the spool in payout (about 9000 g mm2 at spool speed, the spool itself about 19000 full)

deck_extension.note: bolt-on deck tile behind the existing deck (dovetails, heat-set inserts, M3 to the rover like the other tiles); the launcher stays where it is

bends.note: D50 as built: the reel unit is close behind the rail, so the rail-rear pulley moves 150 mm up and down with the aim and the floor segment steepens; at the 6 deg tow pitch everything is straight

SPRING.name: Century C-243 (5/8 x 6-1/2 in x 0.054 in wire)

SW_DOG_L.closes: collar engaged with the LAUNCH dog ring

SW_DOG_R.closes: collar engaged with the REEL gear

SW_INDEX.closes: 6-bump index cam on the main shaft (no-magnet fallback, D12)

SW_N20.closes: N20 engaged (open = hand lever latched out)

SW_HOME.closes: carriage on its front stop (rail lever pressed by a foot under the spring arm)

SW_GAP.closes: big gear in its toothless gap (cam arc on the big gear, switch on the right cheek)

SW_RAIL_LOW.closes: rail at minimum pitch (cam on the aim crank)

SW_SEATED.closes: dart tail against the pusher (rail lever via a carriage plunger, no wires on the carriage)

SW_ARM.closes: CLOSED while the wrap cup is away from home; OPENS for about -6 to +8 deg at home (lever drops into a notch on the cup gear track); firmware home = open

BTS7960.note: 10 k pull-downs on R_EN and L_EN

SWITCHES.free_gpio_note: GPIO38 drives the RGB LED on DevKitC-1 v1.1: not used for contacts

TIMELINE: load
Dart seated on the sled, drum in LAUNCH, rail low, line taut.
aim
Wiper backward: the crank-rocker lifts the rail to 36 deg; the worm holds it.
cock
Wiper forward: the big gear draws the sled back 241 mm; the take-up winds the slack.
fire
The relieved tooth lets go: the sled throws the dart; the big gear resets into its gap.
flight
Dart in flight; the line pays off the storage spool against the fixed 0.25 N LIGHT clutch.
rail_low
D45: wiper backward through the rest of the aim cycle: the rail comes down to 6 deg before the wrap, so tow tension cannot push the carriage back.
neutral
Unload jog, then the drum goes to NEUTRAL: wiper coupled to nothing.
wrap
Right after landing, while the line still lies slack: the drum turns the wrap cup 7 times round the capstan.
wrapped
Drum to the WRAPPED park (314): cup locked, clutch FIRM, collar still NEUTRAL.
anchor
The dart plants its foot and screws its two drills into the ground.
tidy
Wiper forward: the take-up pulls the slack through the free capstan until the line is straight.
reel_engage
Drum into REEL while the wiper creeps forward: the collar drops into the REEL dogs.
tow
Capstan winches the rover toward the anchored dart; sprag #2 holds the load.
release
The base stops (the worm holds the line), then the dart unscrews its drills and lets go.
reel_in
Capstan reels the dart in until about 1.5 m remain.
unload
Wiper jogs 6 deg back inside the dog window, then the drum goes back to the WRAPPED park (314): the collar leaves the REEL dogs.
unwrap
Drum from the park back through the wrap sector to 62, collar in NEUTRAL; the wiper turns forward slowly and the take-up winds the freed line.
approach
Drum to NEUTRAL; the FIRM take-up pulls the dart tail first onto the sled until SW_SEATED.
to_launch
Drum to LAUNCH: clutch LIGHT, collar into the LAUNCH dogs (a 2 deg alignment creep). Rail already low: ready to aim again.
